programme.title: Sevanthi
programme.desc: Sevanthi is daily family entertainment serial in Udaya TV. Arjun and Anuradha both are grandchildren of Pramoda Devi. The family is wanting the duo to get hitched and their closeness has generated such emotion in the hearts of family members. However, because of tragedy befell on family of Anuradha, She end up growing as Sevanthi at an Ashram (orphanage) run by Shantamurthy. The Ashram one day lands in trouble as Sakshi, hailing from an elite family conspires to take over. To safeguard the ashram, Sevanthi approaches Arjun. The popular advocate Arjun put pre-condition of contractual marriage with her, only if Sevanthi agrees to that, he says, he will protect the Ashram. What would happen if a boy who has no belief in relationship and love marries a girl who lives breathing love and care is the knot of the tale.

programme.title: Dragon Ball Super
programme.desc: With Majin Buu now defeated and Earth at peace, the heroes have settled into normal lives, which in Goku's case means being a radish farmer. They can't get too comfortable in their new lives because more evildoers are on the horizon. Enter Beerus, the powerful god of destruction, who awakens -- far away from Earth -- to a prophecy predicting his demise at the hands of an even more formidable being. His search for that being brings him to Earth, where he enters a battle against Goku and his friends. In order to save the world -- again -- they must defeat Beerus, their strongest opponent yet.

credits.actor: Sean Schemmel,Christopher R. Sabat,Jason Douglas,Ian Sinclair,Sonny Strait

programme.sub-title: After defeating Majin Buu, Goku returns to his life as a radish farmer. However, he soon finds himself on a new quest after the rise of Beerus, a powerful being who wants to kill him.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The forest ranger's house is the only area of human civilization in the middle of untamed wilderness in a vast natural reserve in Canada. When the ranger is away, a bear named Grizzy feels that the ranger's house is his territory, given that bears sit at the top of the food chain. After making his way inside the home, Grizzy takes advantage of all the modern conveniences there, including a comfortable sofa, air conditioning and fully equipped kitchen. He's not alone, though, because a group of small creatures called lemmings also populate the ranger's house when he is away. Because Grizzy and the lemmings are not civilized enough to live together in peace, it becomes an atmosphere of madness when the two sides try to outdo each other with tricks.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.sub-title: Grizzly, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.
programme.sub-title: A prowling black panther, tree sap poisonous to the touch, and a week of freezing rain lead a pair of survivalists right up to the breaking point.

programme.title: Dual Survival
programme.desc: Surviving in the wild is not an exact science. Beyond the basics of finding water, food, shelter and eventually help, opinions vary. Two experts tell how they think it's done in this series, as initial episodes feature trained survivalists Dave Canterbury and Cody Lundin demonstrating the skills and creative thinking that can help one cope in tough surroundings. Equipped with minimal gear, the pair are left in remote locations -- an uninhabited island off Nova Scotia, a New Zealand mountaintop, deep in the Everglades, the jungle of Thailand, and the desert of Baja California, to name a few -- where they battle the elements and sometimes each other. Season 3 introduces U.S. Special Ops veteran Joseph Teti to replace Canterbury, in the middle of Season 4 primitive survivalist Matt Graham of Discovery's "Dude, You're Screwed" replaces Lundin, and partway through Season 5 producers forge new partnerships by rotating survival experts as hosts.
programme.sub-title: Dave and Cody endure the harsh conditions of Tierra Del Fuego, 500 miles from Antarctica. To show how to survive an extreme injury, Dave self-inflicts a laceration.

programme.title: Dual Survival
programme.desc: Surviving in the wild is not an exact science. Beyond the basics of finding water, food, shelter and eventually help, opinions vary. Two experts tell how they think it's done in this series, as initial episodes feature trained survivalists Dave Canterbury and Cody Lundin demonstrating the skills and creative thinking that can help one cope in tough surroundings. Equipped with minimal gear, the pair are left in remote locations -- an uninhabited island off Nova Scotia, a New Zealand mountaintop, deep in the Everglades, the jungle of Thailand, and the desert of Baja California, to name a few -- where they battle the elements and sometimes each other. Season 3 introduces U.S. Special Ops veteran Joseph Teti to replace Canterbury, in the middle of Season 4 primitive survivalist Matt Graham of Discovery's "Dude, You're Screwed" replaces Lundin, and partway through Season 5 producers forge new partnerships by rotating survival experts as hosts.
programme.sub-title: Dave and Cody endure the harsh conditions of Tierra Del Fuego, 500 miles from Antarctica. To show how to survive an extreme injury, Dave self-inflicts a laceration.

programme.title: Shaun the Sheep
programme.desc: Shaun the Sheep thinks and acts like a person in a barnyard, which usually gets him into trouble. The farmer's sheepdog, Bitzer, tries to keep Shaun and his friends out of trouble. The farmer is oblivious to the humanlike features of his flock, who are like one big, happy family.
programme.sub-title: Shaun, a remarkably intelligent sheep and leader of his flock at Mossy Bottom Farm, endeavours to inject some thrill into their monotonous routine while avoiding detection by the farmer.

programme.title: Web of Lies
programme.desc: With one quick click the internet allows people to share information like family photos and professional accomplishments, making it easy to ignore or forget that behind clever screen names and witty captions is a dark digital world with real dangers and risks. In hourlong episodes, Web of Lies unravels tragic stories of deception and manipulation triggered by online interactions, from predators lurking behind Facebook profiles to creeps scouring chat rooms for their victims. Re-enactments are buttressed by comments from law enforcement personnel, true-crime experts and psychologists, plus first-person accounts from friends and families of the victims.
programme.sub-title: Retiree Alex Strategos is consumed by loneliness. He turns to internet dating and finds 69-year-old Melissa, but is soon struck by a rush of unexplained illnesses.

programme.title: Betrayed
programme.desc: The filmmaker uncovers shocking true stories of trust shattered by murder, following investigations told from the victims' perspectives.
programme.sub-title: After getting a divorce, Janet celebrates her freedom with a girls' night. When she's found dead, it takes the police 35 years to bring her murder to justice.

programme.title: Blood Relatives
programme.desc: From the outside, families seem like harmonious units in loving homes. But you don't necessarily know what secrets families are hiding from the outside world. This series, narrated by actress Brenda Strong, explores families hiding the most extreme of family secrets: murder. Each episode explores a death in a family, unraveling the motives of the family members, all of whom are potential suspects -- and potential victims. Sibling rivalries, disputes over family businesses and infidelity are some of the factors that lead to the families' ultimate betrayals.
programme.sub-title: One family in a small town in the Pacific Northwest seems to have it all, until a secret video and a stash of guns reveals the face of a diabolical killer.

programme.title: Haunted Towns
programme.desc: Featured on the Destination America series "Ghost Asylum," the Tennessee Wraith Chasers take their specter-hunting skills on the road to investigate America's most haunted towns. The team -- founder Chris Smith, co-founder Steven McDougal, historian Scott Porter, and trap inventor Brannon Smith -- travels to paranormal hotspots like Salem, Mass., Bisbee, Ariz., and Gettysburg, Pa., to interview witnesses and follow leads to try to pinpoint who is haunting the towns and why. Spooky stories in such places have been passed down through generations. Is it simply folklore, or is it true?
programme.sub-title: The team head to the Old Idaho State Penitentiary. Here, they hope to encounter the spirits of two infamous murderers who are rumoured to haunt the building.

programme.title: True Conviction
programme.desc: Anna-Sigga Nicolazzi examines cases through the eyes of a prosecutor and shares her insights into how the complex threads of a murder investigation come together in the courtroom.
programme.sub-title: Single mother Donna Willard answers the door to a hooded gunman who shoots and kills her, while her 12-year-old son watches from the top of the stairs. Anna-Sigga Nicolazzi revisits the crime and reveals how justice was won for the Willard family.

programme.title: Evil Lives Here
programme.desc: Through personal interviews, various people share their terrifying stories of having shared a home and life with a loved one who became a killer.
programme.sub-title: Dennis Ryan grows up believing his father's violent teachings will prepare him to save the lives of everyone in their farmhouse, then the teenager discovers the horrible truth.

programme.sub-title: In Alabama, murder is on the menu at a party after one family's distrust and finger pointing lead detectives on a cross-country search for a killer.

programme.title: The Perfect Murder
programme.desc: When a crime scene throws suspicion in multiple directions, investigators may have a perfect murder on their hands. Ingenious killers are every detective's worst nightmare, as the crimes they commit are full of leads that become dead ends, and multiple suspects are ultimately discarded. But just when a murderer thinks he or she has successfully gotten away with it, one small clue leads to another and a cold case suddenly turns hot. "The Perfect Murder" follows actual cases and uses stylized re-enactments depicting detectives slowly putting the pieces together to complete intricate puzzles.

programme.sub-title: Peter Theriault has not missed a day of work in almost 30 years. So, when he fails to arrive for his shift at a car plant, friends and family immediately suspect something is very wrong.

programme.title: Who on Earth Did I Marry?
programme.desc: The filmmaker portrays the stories of married men and women who have unknowingly tied the knot with criminals, including swindlers and bank robbers.
programme.sub-title: Andie Nash is devastated when the man she has been dating, Simon Reid, vanishes mysteriously, and she starts to get suspicious.

programme.title: Redrum
programme.desc: As its title implies, "Redrum" works in reverse. The true crime series flips the script of traditional mystery programming by starting the stories at the scene of the crimes and working backward to reveal the killers. Told with the help of interviews with friends and family close to the victim -- and sometimes even the killer -- each story integrates the interviews with stylized re-creations to show how investigators piece together a case, tracing a series of intersecting events and relationships that unfolded to arrive at the root of the crime.
programme.sub-title: Tyrannised by his father and traumatised by his sexually abusive scout master, Heath takes a gun to his family; will more violence follow this massacre?

programme.title: The Murder Tapes
programme.desc: Following real-life murder investigation as it is being conducted in real time; using raw and unfiltered footage to bring out the truth.
programme.sub-title: Tempers flare outside a home where Savannah police officers discover three bodies; one argument may offer a vital lead in the case.

programme.sub-title: In 2001, a man's visit home turns into a desperate search for his missing father. A detective uncovers a murder with a stunning revelation about a group of children and a woman struggles to believe her son could be involved in a vicious crime.

programme.sub-title: When Debra Davis' husband excoriates her for refusing to experiment sexually, she thought there was something wrong with her, never suspecting her husband's perversions are signs of something evil deep inside him.

programme.title: Disappeared
programme.desc: Here today, gone tomorrow. Thousands of people go missing in the United States each year, leaving behind only a mystery without any clues. Their stories are told in `Disappeared' through the voices of family, friends and investigators trying to solve the case, with each hourlong episode recounting the final stages that led to a person's disappearance. Interviews with experts including psychologists and forensic specialists provide new insights into what may have happened - whether foul play was involved or the subject simply ran away.

credits.actor: Christopher Walker,Rachel Daigh,Jesse Felix,James Garcia,David Namminga,Flora Rubenhold

programme.sub-title: Former basketball star Rico Harris mysteriously vanishes while driving to Seattle. Investigators start a journey that becomes more baffling as time passes.

programme.title: Ghost Asylum
programme.desc: The Tennessee Wraith Chasers (TWC) are passionate paranormal investigators. The team have a specific niche in the supernatural realm - seeking out activity at asylums, sanitariums and mental hospitals. Unlike other teams, TWC isn't content to conjure up incorporeal beings and collect evidence; it uses traps to capture restless spirits. With common sense and adventurous tendencies, the team either debunk or validate each case it researches, whose venues include hospitals where dead nurses roam the halls and a rehab center that has cries coming from the windows.
programme.sub-title: The Tennessee Wraith Chasers travel to the heart of Ohio to investigate the most haunted prison in America - Mansfield Reformatory.

programme.title: Alien Encounters: Fact or Fiction
programme.desc: UFO experts Mitch Horowitz and Chrissy Newton use scientific data and research to dissect real-life encounters with extraterrestrial activity and determine whether they can be explained.
programme.sub-title: A lobsterman from Maine relives a harrowing encounter that has haunted him for years, a family witnesses a strange string of lights in the sky, and a man believes he can communicate with alien crafts.

programme.title: The Curious Case of Natalia Grace: Natalia Speaks
programme.desc: The true story surrounding Michael and Kristine Barnett's adoption of an adult who was accused of pretending to be a 6-year-old Ukrainian orphan.
programme.sub-title: Natalia and Michael square off again in a no-holds-barred confrontation. Natalia is looking for more than answers from Michael, and she wants evidence and admissions to the abuses she suffered at the hands of Michael and Kristine.

programme.title: Body Cam
programme.desc: "It's not like in the movies," police Sgt. David White says, describing his encounter with a gun-wielding suspect that was captured on his body camera. The video is among those featured on this series, which offers unprecedented access to police units that are using this innovative and vital technology in the line of duty. The series takes viewers on the "ultimate ride-along" as they view the life-or-death, split-second decisions that those in law enforcement are forced to make on a daily basis. Each story weaves interviews with responding officers throughout to provide critical context to their decisions and to add additional insight to the life-changing, sometimes tragically fatal, moments.
programme.sub-title: An armed suspect fires at police before embarking on a dangerous pursuit; a man locks himself in his garage, but it catches fire, and police don't know if they're on a rescue mission or victims of an ambush.

programme.title: Operation Undercover
programme.desc: Exclusive access to real-life undercover stings targeting arms dealers, drug suppliers, human traffickers and various other criminal enterprises.
programme.sub-title: Facing an influx of drug problems, the Winchester PD joins forces with a regional task force and takes on a suspected fentanyl trafficker, a dealer reportedly selling cocaine around children and an ex-felon who may have ties to a major supplier.

programme.sub-title: Zak and the guys give an inside look at what it takes to investigate a demonic home invasion as they revisit a terrifying case in Nevada. Moved by a family's pleas for help, the crew works fast to uncover the dark source of their invisible attacker.

programme.desc: Featured on the Destination America series "Ghost Asylum," the Tennessee Wraith Chasers take their specter-hunting skills on the road to investigate America's most haunted towns. The team -- founder Chris Smith, co-founder Steven McDougal, historian Scott Porter, and trap inventor Brannon Smith -- travels to paranormal hotspots like Salem, Mass., Bisbee, Ariz., and Gettysburg, Pa., to interview witnesses and follow leads to try to pinpoint who is haunting the towns and why. Spooky stories in such places have been passed down through generations. Is it simply folklore, or is it true?
programme.sub-title: The team head to the Old Idaho State Penitentiary. Here, they hope to encounter the spirits of two infamous murderers who are rumoured to haunt the building.

programme.title: Shattered
programme.desc: The filmmaker delves into the ripple effects of a single crime, showing how it can forever alter multiple lives. Through real homicide cases, loved ones, eyewitnesses, and law enforcement share how the past continues to haunt the present.
programme.sub-title: In 2006, residents in Indianapolis called 911 to report gunfire coming from a house. Police find a total of seven bodies in a terrible mass shooting.

programme.title: Betrayed
programme.desc: The filmmaker uncovers shocking true stories of trust shattered by murder, following investigations told from the victims' perspectives.

credits.actor: Jack Aversano,Julian Brandon Bereny,Brent Duffey,Olivia Dunkley,Drew Hale,Bryan Hanna

programme.sub-title: A retired prison officer thinks he's lived through the riskiest years of his life, but handling his second wife and her jealous ex-husband proves far more deadly.

programme.title: Who on Earth Did I Marry?
programme.desc: The filmmaker portrays the stories of married men and women who have unknowingly tied the knot with criminals, including swindlers and bank robbers.
programme.sub-title: Ryan is climbing the career ladder and all he needs for a perfect life is the perfect woman to share it with. But is the beautiful Jodi as impeccable as she seems?

programme.title: Web of Lies
programme.desc: With one quick click the internet allows people to share information like family photos and professional accomplishments, making it easy to ignore or forget that behind clever screen names and witty captions is a dark digital world with real dangers and risks. In hourlong episodes, Web of Lies unravels tragic stories of deception and manipulation triggered by online interactions, from predators lurking behind Facebook profiles to creeps scouring chat rooms for their victims. Re-enactments are buttressed by comments from law enforcement personnel, true-crime experts and psychologists, plus first-person accounts from friends and families of the victims.
programme.sub-title: Beverly Carter is a 50-year-old internet savvy real-estate agent. But when she goes to meet a prospective buyer at a remote house, she never returns.

programme.title: Blood Relatives
programme.desc: From the outside, families seem like harmonious units in loving homes. But you don't necessarily know what secrets families are hiding from the outside world. This series, narrated by actress Brenda Strong, explores families hiding the most extreme of family secrets: murder. Each episode explores a death in a family, unraveling the motives of the family members, all of whom are potential suspects -- and potential victims. Sibling rivalries, disputes over family businesses and infidelity are some of the factors that lead to the families' ultimate betrayals.
programme.sub-title: In Alabama, murder is on the menu at a party after one family's distrust and finger pointing lead detectives on a cross-country search for a killer.

programme.title: The Perfect Murder
programme.desc: When a crime scene throws suspicion in multiple directions, investigators may have a perfect murder on their hands. Ingenious killers are every detective's worst nightmare, as the crimes they commit are full of leads that become dead ends, and multiple suspects are ultimately discarded. But just when a murderer thinks he or she has successfully gotten away with it, one small clue leads to another and a cold case suddenly turns hot. "The Perfect Murder" follows actual cases and uses stylized re-enactments depicting detectives slowly putting the pieces together to complete intricate puzzles.

credits.actor: Bill Graves,Andres Chairez,Bill Cannon,Lisa Tirone King,Jacqueline Lee

programme.sub-title: Peter Theriault has not missed a day of work in almost 30 years. So, when he fails to arrive for his shift at a car plant, friends and family immediately suspect something is very wrong.

programme.title: Who on Earth Did I Marry?
programme.desc: The filmmaker portrays the stories of married men and women who have unknowingly tied the knot with criminals, including swindlers and bank robbers.
programme.sub-title: Andie Nash is devastated when the man she has been dating, Simon Reid, vanishes mysteriously, and she starts to get suspicious.

programme.title: Redrum
programme.desc: As its title implies, "Redrum" works in reverse. The true crime series flips the script of traditional mystery programming by starting the stories at the scene of the crimes and working backward to reveal the killers. Told with the help of interviews with friends and family close to the victim -- and sometimes even the killer -- each story integrates the interviews with stylized re-creations to show how investigators piece together a case, tracing a series of intersecting events and relationships that unfolded to arrive at the root of the crime.
programme.sub-title: Tyrannised by his father and traumatised by his sexually abusive scout master, Heath takes a gun to his family; will more violence follow this massacre?

programme.title: The Murder Tapes
programme.desc: Following real-life murder investigation as it is being conducted in real time; using raw and unfiltered footage to bring out the truth.
programme.sub-title: Tempers flare outside a home where Savannah police officers discover three bodies; one argument may offer a vital lead in the case.

programme.title: Shattered
programme.desc: The filmmaker delves into the ripple effects of a single crime, showing how it can forever alter multiple lives. Through real homicide cases, loved ones, eyewitnesses, and law enforcement share how the past continues to haunt the present.
programme.sub-title: In 2001, a man's visit home turns into a desperate search for his missing father. A detective uncovers a murder with a stunning revelation about a group of children and a woman struggles to believe her son could be involved in a vicious crime.

programme.title: Evil Lives Here
programme.desc: Through personal interviews, various people share their terrifying stories of having shared a home and life with a loved one who became a killer.

credits.actor: Benjamin Oduro,Brooke Turner,Gillian Todd,Dexter Strong,Mark Montalbano,Elizabeth Everett

programme.sub-title: When Debra Davis' husband excoriates her for refusing to experiment sexually, she thought there was something wrong with her, never suspecting her husband's perversions are signs of something evil deep inside him.

programme.title: Disappeared
programme.desc: Here today, gone tomorrow. Thousands of people go missing in the United States each year, leaving behind only a mystery without any clues. Their stories are told in `Disappeared' through the voices of family, friends and investigators trying to solve the case, with each hourlong episode recounting the final stages that led to a person's disappearance. Interviews with experts including psychologists and forensic specialists provide new insights into what may have happened - whether foul play was involved or the subject simply ran away.

credits.actor: Christopher Walker,Rachel Daigh,Jesse Felix,James Garcia,David Namminga,Flora Rubenhold

programme.sub-title: Former basketball star Rico Harris mysteriously vanishes while driving to Seattle. Investigators start a journey that becomes more baffling as time passes.

programme.title: Ghost Asylum
programme.desc: The Tennessee Wraith Chasers (TWC) are passionate paranormal investigators. The team have a specific niche in the supernatural realm - seeking out activity at asylums, sanitariums and mental hospitals. Unlike other teams, TWC isn't content to conjure up incorporeal beings and collect evidence; it uses traps to capture restless spirits. With common sense and adventurous tendencies, the team either debunk or validate each case it researches, whose venues include hospitals where dead nurses roam the halls and a rehab center that has cries coming from the windows.
programme.sub-title: The Tennessee Wraith Chasers travel to the heart of Ohio to investigate the most haunted prison in America - Mansfield Reformatory.

programme.title: Blood Relatives
programme.desc: From the outside, families seem like harmonious units in loving homes. But you don't necessarily know what secrets families are hiding from the outside world. This series, narrated by actress Brenda Strong, explores families hiding the most extreme of family secrets: murder. Each episode explores a death in a family, unraveling the motives of the family members, all of whom are potential suspects -- and potential victims. Sibling rivalries, disputes over family businesses and infidelity are some of the factors that lead to the families' ultimate betrayals.
programme.sub-title: One family in a small town in the Pacific Northwest seems to have it all, until a secret video and a stash of guns reveals the face of a diabolical killer.

programme.title: True Conviction
programme.desc: Anna-Sigga Nicolazzi examines cases through the eyes of a prosecutor and shares her insights into how the complex threads of a murder investigation come together in the courtroom.
programme.sub-title: Single mother Donna Willard answers the door to a hooded gunman who shoots and kills her, while her 12-year-old son watches from the top of the stairs. Anna-Sigga Nicolazzi revisits the crime and reveals how justice was won for the Willard family.

programme.title: Alien Encounters: Fact or Fiction
programme.desc: UFO experts Mitch Horowitz and Chrissy Newton use scientific data and research to dissect real-life encounters with extraterrestrial activity and determine whether they can be explained.
programme.sub-title: A lobsterman from Maine relives a harrowing encounter that has haunted him for years, a family witnesses a strange string of lights in the sky, and a man believes he can communicate with alien crafts.

programme.title: The Curious Case of Natalia Grace: Natalia Speaks
programme.desc: The true story surrounding Michael and Kristine Barnett's adoption of an adult who was accused of pretending to be a 6-year-old Ukrainian orphan.
programme.sub-title: Natalia and Michael square off again in a no-holds-barred confrontation. Natalia is looking for more than answers from Michael, and she wants evidence and admissions to the abuses she suffered at the hands of Michael and Kristine.

programme.title: Body Cam
programme.desc: "It's not like in the movies," police Sgt. David White says, describing his encounter with a gun-wielding suspect that was captured on his body camera. The video is among those featured on this series, which offers unprecedented access to police units that are using this innovative and vital technology in the line of duty. The series takes viewers on the "ultimate ride-along" as they view the life-or-death, split-second decisions that those in law enforcement are forced to make on a daily basis. Each story weaves interviews with responding officers throughout to provide critical context to their decisions and to add additional insight to the life-changing, sometimes tragically fatal, moments.
programme.sub-title: An armed suspect fires at police before embarking on a dangerous pursuit; a man locks himself in his garage, but it catches fire, and police don't know if they're on a rescue mission or victims of an ambush.

programme.title: Operation Undercover
programme.desc: Exclusive access to real-life undercover stings targeting arms dealers, drug suppliers, human traffickers and various other criminal enterprises.
programme.sub-title: Facing an influx of drug problems, the Winchester PD joins forces with a regional task force and takes on a suspected fentanyl trafficker, a dealer reportedly selling cocaine around children and an ex-felon who may have ties to a major supplier.

programme.title: Ghost Adventures: Screaming Room
programme.desc: Paranormal investigators Zak Bagans, Aaron Goodwin, Jay Wasley and Billy Tolley kick back in their screening room to watch their favourite episodes of "Ghost Adventures", while providing commentary about their craziest experiences.
programme.sub-title: Zak and the guys give an inside look at what it takes to investigate a demonic home invasion as they revisit a terrifying case in Nevada. Moved by a family's pleas for help, the crew works fast to uncover the dark source of their invisible attacker.

Enter Beerus, the powerful god of destruction, who awakens -- far away from Earth -- to a prophecy predicting his demise at the hands of an even more formidable being. programme.sub-title: After being isolated during most of the pandemic, a doctor and her wife are ready to entertain again; inspired by their love of wine and gardening, Jenni Yolo redesigns their kitchen to create a warm and inviting space.

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress
programme.desc: Sales associates and managers at various stores across Manhattan help nervous brides choose the perfect dress for their wedding.
programme.sub-title: Excitement's in the air for both the brides and Randy who's going back to his bridal design roots! Jenni Pulos has a surprise for her friend, Monica.

programme.title: 90 Day Fiancé: Love In Paradise
programme.desc: Four couples go to great lengths to fight for their love amidst several challenges on an island that appears to look like paradise.
programme.sub-title: Daniel shocks Amber when he drops a bomb on her, the morning after spending an amazing night together. Mark and Key have a passionate reunion in the Caribbean and reminisce about old times.

programme.title: Love & Translation
programme.desc: Without a shared language or the use of a translator, this series explores how singles looking for love come together in the attempt to find a connection.
programme.sub-title: Dylan has a sexual encounter that threatens his relationships with other women. Tripp attempts to rekindle an old flame. And Kahlil tests out a connection with Imane.

programme.title: Descending
programme.desc: In this 13-part documentary series, hosts Scott Wilson and Ellis Emmett descend beneath the surface to explore the three-quarters of the planet that is covered in water. Each episode features a new location, where Wilson and Emmett discover all that the area has to offer. They explore the cultures of the local people, share stories of human triumph and tragedy, and connect the world on land to the one in the sea. With each dive into the unknown, they encounter creatures and sights that most people will never get to experience.
